rationale: The Agent Mode feature guide requires Platform 10.1.x+, a supported AWS location, enabled Model Runtime, and Cloud Connected certificate/callback configuration. The 2.3.6 installation guide still plans 2.4.0 support, excludes 2.2.0–2.3.6, and its 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode. The current feature minimum does not establish a usable Enterprise Cloud Connected path. A complete fresh runtime routing assessment was not completed.

exclusions: No supported Cloud Connected 2.4.0 release or tenant availability is established.
